The `allBlocksAreNulls` variable is set to `false` when a non-null value is found in the `valuesBlock`. However, this logic can be simplified by using the logical NOT operator directly on the `isNull` method. This would make the code more concise and easier to read.
```java
boolean allBlocksAreNulls = valuesBlock.isNull(p);
```

In the `calculatePercentile` method of `MvPercentileTests`, the `expected` value is calculated using a custom implementation. It would be more maintainable and less error-prone to use a well-tested library or framework for percentile calculations, such as Apache Commons Math.
